text:
maria: folks - we just got a customer escalation. Dedicated pool dp-prod-03 dropped from ~1.2k rps to ~350 rps over ~6m. Customer seeing timeouts and 429s. Not a deploy.
ops-bot: alert: high-token-latency on dp-prod-03 (avg token latency 145ms -> 420ms) triggered at 2345678820
samir: moving to investigate. maria can you paste the request pattern / payload sizes?
maria: payloads are mixed, but heavy tail of 8-12k tokens in the last 30m. Most requests are chat streaming, continuous-batcher enabled. No auth errors in their logs.
lia: I see higher queue depth for tenant:acme-inc on dp-prod-03, and several microbatches hitting the max_batch_tokens cap repeatedly. Looks like prefill + long generations are fragmenting windows.
jordan: hmm could be starvation from big-token requests causing batching inefficiency. Any noisy-tenant throttles firing?
maya: checking billing/auth quickly - tenant is fine on quota. No recent plan change. auth/jwt passed.
alex: repro steps I ran locally against a canary:
```bash
# flood with long chat inputs, continuous batching on
for i in {1..50}; do 
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream \
    -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TEST' \
    -d '{"model":"gptx-8k","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"long_text_9k_tokens"}],"stream":true}' &
done
```
Tail from runtime logs showing batch packing stalls: 
```
2024-11-05T12:13:22Z prefiller: queued tokens=9800 tenant=acme-inc pool=dp-prod-03
2024-11-05T12:13:22Z scheduler: chose batch_id=1345 token_sum=9800 waiting=12
2024-11-05T12:13:23Z batcher: dispatch delayed -> waiting for window 100ms (prefill threshold)
2024-11-05T12:13:23Z kernel: exec latency spike 380ms batch_id=1345
```
alex: result - continuous-batcher ends up creating several oversized batches that block smaller gen requests. Throughput falls even though GPU is <80% util.
samir: possible quick mitigations?
jordan: immediate: reduce max_batch_tokens for dp-prod-03 from 10000 -> 4096 and enable per-tenant microbatching (fair weight) for acme-inc. That will force splitting big requests so they don't block small ones.
lia: also toggle continuous_batcher.prefill_threshold_ms down from 100 -> 20 to reduce wait windows. But watch latency SLOs.
maria: will that require a restart? We can roll config via runtime hot-reload on pool with no restart. Plan to patch at 2345679000 if agreed.
maya: I'll inform CS and the customer about a temporary mitigation.
alex: I'll keep running the flood repro after the change and post results.
samir: create a follow-up ticket for SRE to analyze packing algorithm (priority P1) and to consider better per-tenant batching isolation. Ticket: INC-2345.
maria: assigning: samir (owner), alex (repro + logs), lia (config changes), maya (customer comms). Target postmortem in 48h.
jordan: adding note: long-term we should consider adaptive max_batch_tokens based on sequence-length distribution per-tenant.
maria: thanks everyone. actioning now. :thumbsup:
